recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not rename Observation.encounter or add EpisodeOfCare directly to the core element unless a future work-group decision reverses FHIR-42761; any rendering/tooling follow-up for extension search parameters should continue through the FHIR-42762 Extension Pack path.
issue_request: FHIR-33166 is an Applied OO change request with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked O&O to revisit Observation.encounter/context and EpisodeOfCare support; the final accepted action was to update Observation.encounter's short display text to direct implementers to the workflow-episodeOfCare extension for one or more episodes of care.
initial_application: Commit b7d6acf83a65ce92de0da2393608a71fe849dacc applied the Jira-tagged source change by adding the workflow-episodeOfCare guidance to source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml. Cleanup commit b8984e5cbeec78445a9bcb7398943b1b57e916bc aligned source/observation/observation-event-mapping-exceptions.xml with the same short text.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-17661/FHIR-17901 are the historical decisions that split encounter from EpisodeOfCare extension support. FHIR-42761 later rejected changing Event.encounter back to an EpisodeOfCare-capable context element, while FHIR-42762 accepted a workflow-EpisodeOfCare extension search parameter maintained in the Extension Pack. The Extension Pack source currently defines the extension and search parameter with Observation listed as a base.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative Observation source already conveys the approved guidance, the Event mapping exception source is consistent, and the related extension/search-parameter support belongs to the Extension Pack rather than this core checkout.
